description: MobileNetV2-based pest detection model trained on the IP102 dataset. Classifies crop pest images into 102 agricultural pest categories.

preprocessing.comment: INT8 quantized: pixel values scaled to [-128, 127] via (pixel/127.5 - 1.0) * 127

evaluation.note: Run evaluation module with labeled test data to obtain accuracy.

pest_recommendations.default: Consult a local agricultural extension officer for pest management advice.
pest_recommendations.aphids: Apply neem oil spray or introduce natural predators such as ladybugs. Avoid broad-spectrum pesticides.
pest_recommendations.army worm: Use Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) biopesticide. Monitor fields at dawn and dusk.
pest_recommendations.corn borer: Apply Trichogramma parasitoids. Use pheromone traps for monitoring.
pest_recommendations.rice leaf roller: Drain fields and apply appropriate insecticides if infestation exceeds economic threshold.
pest_recommendations.brown plant hopper: Reduce nitrogen fertilizer use. Apply contact insecticides in severe cases.
pest_recommendations.rice leafhopper: Use resistant varieties and apply imidacloprid if threshold is exceeded.
pest_recommendations.mole cricket: Apply chlorpyrifos granules at field margins during evening hours.
pest_recommendations.wireworm: Rotate crops. Apply soil insecticides before planting.
pest_recommendations.flea beetle: Use row covers. Apply spinosad or pyrethrin if severe.
pest_recommendations.whitefly: Use yellow sticky traps. Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil spray.
pest_recommendations.mealybug: Introduce Cryptolaemus montrouzieri (mealybug destroyer). Use rubbing alcohol on small infestations.
pest_recommendations.mites: Increase humidity around plants. Apply miticides or neem oil.
pest_recommendations.thrips: Use blue sticky traps. Apply spinosad-based insecticide.
pest_recommendations.scale insect: Prune infested branches. Apply horticultural oil during dormant season.

label_note: Labels 1-53 from IP102 classes.txt. Labels 54-102 are approximate class names based on IP102 crop categories. Update if you know the exact class mapping from your training notebook.
